This yields the relative-`..` (M4), absolute-path/`os.path.join` root-discard (M8), and lexical-prefix/symlink (M8) shapes.
- The static and asset routes (`routes.py:45-99`, `server.py:415-435`) delegate containment to tornado's inherited `get_absolute_path`/`validate_absolute_path`; Streamlit's page-name rewrite (`routes.py:64-85`) runs before that check and does not open a hole. `/media/` is in-memory only (`routes.py:151-205`, `in_memory_file_manager.py:295-303`), with a weak caller-supplied identity prefix (M10) but no filesystem read.
- T1/T2/T3 are one independent group because a single correct normalized containment check closes all three; the optional T4 is a separate in-memory weakness not tied to CWE-22. Hence `usable: false` for the 3-5-independent-trap stacking bar.
